sql: SELECT exchange,min(cal_date),max(cal_date),count(*),count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_open='1') FROM calendar GROUP BY exchange ORDER BY exchange
SELECT DISTINCT try_strptime(cal_date,'%Y%m%d')::date FROM calendar WHERE exchange='SSE' AND is_open='1'
SELECT DISTINCT cal_date FROM calendar WHERE exchange='SSE'

SELECT a.cal_date,a.is_open AS sse_open,b.is_open AS szse_open FROM calendar a FULL JOIN calendar b ON a.cal_date=b.cal_date AND b.exchange='SZSE' WHERE a.exchange='SSE' AND (a.is_open<>b.is_open OR b.cal_date IS NULL) ORDER BY 1

SELECT exchange,count(*) AS mismatches FROM (SELECT *,max(CASE WHEN is_open='1' THEN cal_date END) OVER(PARTITION BY exchange ORDER BY cal_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS previous_open FROM calendar) WHERE previous_open IS NOT NULL AND pretrade_date<>previous_open GROUP BY exchange
SELECT endpoint,status,error_kind,count(*),sum(rows),max(updated_at) FROM fetch_tasks GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT task_id,endpoint,status,error_kind,task,rows,updated_at FROM fetch_tasks WHERE status<>'SUCCESS' ORDER BY endpoint,task_id

SELECT json_extract_string(task,'$.parameters.ts_code'),status,error_kind,count(*),sum(rows),min(json_extract_string(task,'$.requested_start')),max(json_extract_string(task,'$.requested_end')) FROM fetch_tasks WHERE endpoint='index_daily' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT endpoint,count(*),min(json_extract_string(task,'$.requested_start')),max(json_extract_string(task,'$.requested_end')) FROM fetch_tasks WHERE status='SUCCESS' AND rows=0 GROUP BY endpoint ORDER BY 1
SELECT endpoint,status,count(*) FROM data_quality_results GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT endpoint,state,count(*),sum(rows) FROM raw_batches GROUP BY ALL
SELECT endpoint,active,count(*),sum(rows) FROM canonical_parts GROUP BY ALL
SELECT endpoint,path,rows,content_hash FROM canonical_parts WHERE active ORDER BY endpoint,path
SELECT endpoint,status FROM endpoint_capabilities
